==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|driver license|drivers license}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-driver's license.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{sid|en|Q205647}}{{lb|en|American spelling}} A [[document]] issued to a specific person by a [[government]] [[authority]], permitting this person to drive one or more classes of [[motor vehicle]] on public roads and [[highway]]s, often used as an [[identification]] document.

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|Hong Kong|India|Ireland|Malta|Pakistan|UK}} {{l|en|driving licence}}
* {{sense|Australia, Canada, New Zealand}} {{l|en|driver's licence}}
* {{l|en|driver licence}}
